The plate is about 355 px across. If it is a ~26 cm dinner plate, that is roughly 13.6 px per cm.

The pizza slice measures about 190 px long diagonally, or roughly 14 cm, and about 95 px wide, or roughly 7 cm. It is a rectangular slice of thick-crust, focaccia-like pizza, probably 1.5 cm thick.

Its volume is about 14 × 7 × 1.5 ≈ 147 cm³. Bread-like pizza has a density of about 0.6 g/cm³, which gives roughly 90 g, so I'll estimate 100 g.

Pizza runs about 250-270 kcal per 100 g, so a 100 g slice with cheese, sauce, and basil comes to about 260 kcal.
